instruction: Inspect only the supplied visual sources and the supplied SAME/DISTINCT cues with exact provenance. Treat every cue only as evidence motivating the competition, never as a conclusion. Do NOT decide whether they are the same physical object. Decide only whether the pixels support a precise perceptual discriminant whose observable outcomes would differ across the already-open alternatives. If no such reliable discriminant exists, return no_reliable_discriminant; if the exposed sources cannot establish whether such a discriminant exists, return insufficient_visual_evidence. For a proposal, return discriminant_available, choose one opaque property token and opaque outcome tokens only from the allowed lists, and document their perceptual meaning in non-executable description fields. Do not infer from architectural plausibility and do not treat non-visible/occluded evidence as absence.

cues.cue: Both observations show a broad pale rendered wall with a tall white-framed upper opening near one lateral edge.

The visible opening layouts differ: the photo-4 wall exposes an additional lower-right glazed opening that is not within the photo-2 wall evidence region; this is only a distinctness cue because field-of-view/occlusion can account for non-visibility.

response_invariants: response.request_id and identity_candidate_id MUST exactly match the request.
discriminant_available requires the complete discriminant payload; no_reliable_discriminant and insufficient_visual_evidence require every discriminant payload field to be null/absent.
The supplied SAME/DISTINCT cues are evidence for constructing a test, not identity conclusions.
property_name MUST be one of request.allowed_property_names; prose descriptions are non-executable and MUST NOT be parsed by the engine.
Every outcome token MUST be one of request.allowed_outcomes.
source_ids_by_observation MUST exactly equal the observation_ref→source_id mapping supplied by the request.
required_source_ids MUST be unique and a subset of request source IDs.
outcomes_by_alternative keys MUST exactly equal request.open_alternatives; each alternative MUST have at least one outcome; every used outcome MUST map to exactly one alternative.
A proposed discriminant MUST give observably different outcome tokens to the two alternatives; otherwise return no_reliable_discriminant.
absence of an index != proof of the opposite; non-visible != absent; occluded != absent; architectural plausibility MUST NOT be used as evidence.
